findings.label: Lossy-path collisions
findings.detail: Distinct non-UTF-8 names (e.g. b"\xff.txt", b"\xfe.txt") both store path "\ufffd.txt", producing duplicate diff.json entries; consider a distinguishable spelling (e.g. backslashreplace) as a follow-up.

findings.label: Stale serializer docstring
findings.detail: backend/runs/serializers.py FileDiffStatSerializer docstring still says patch_truncated means 'patch is only a prefix'; update to the widened meaning (scan did not see the whole patch, including patch-less non-UTF-8 entries).

findings.label: Overflow to ClickException not tested end to end
findings.detail: The overflow test asserts GitCaptureError; the ClickException mapping is covered only by the generic test_run_reports_a_git_capture_failure_and_still_tears_the_sandbox_down. Optional CLI-level test would pin the user-facing message.
